text: Program Description Main Courses and credits Compulsory Courses Credits Elective Courses Credits Management 3 Chinese Financial Markets 2 Accounting 3 Chinese Business Law 2 Finance 3 Chinese Foreign Trade 2 International Finance 3 Investment Banking 3 Business Statistics 3 Chinese Economy 3 International Financial Management 3 Personal Finance Planning 2 Financial Management 3 Global Financial Market 2 Security Investment 3 Chinese Banking System 2 Investments 3 International Trade 3 Portofolio Management 3 Multinational Financial Management 2 Corporate Finance 3 Financial Derivatives 3 Thesis (4 Credits) In the fourth year of their study, students must complete a thesis related to their major to meet the graduation requirements. The length of the thesis should be around 8000 words. The thesis is a milestone assessment on the intended level of achievement both in the major and the general learning outcomes by the students. Specifically, students, must demonstrate the ability to apply their learning to complex, unscripted problems in the context of their advanced studies, the mastery of the skills required for their disciplines as well as essential learning outcomes including the breadth and the depth of their knowledge, critical and creative thinking, problem solving, the ability to integrate knowledge and skills and present their work in an appropriate manner. Academic Calendar Fall Semester: the beginning of September to next January Spring Semester: the beginning of March to the beginning of July Summer Vacation: the beginning of July to the end of August Time Registration Time of Spring Semester : February 27-March 2 Beginning Time of Spring Semester: March 5 Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package.
